## How one change becomes a release

```mermaid
graph TB
  Oleg@{ icon: "fa:user", shape: rounded, label: "Oleg Konyk" }
  KonyklabsRoadmapIssues@{ shape: cylinder, label: "issues" }
  KonyklabsRoadmapAdrs@{ shape: cylinder, label: "decisions/" }
  Github@{ shape: rectangle, label: "GitHub" }
  KonyklabsDotgithubTitleLint@{ shape: rectangle, label: "title-lint.yml" }
  KonyklabsDotgithubScan@{ shape: rectangle, label: "proprietary-scan.yml" }
  KonyklabsDotgithubGate@{ shape: rectangle, label: "claude-review.yml" }
  KonyklabsSite@{ shape: rectangle, label: "site" }
  KonyklabsDotgithubReleasePlease@{ shape: rectangle, label: "release-please.yml" }
  Oleg -. "`files an idea`" .-> KonyklabsRoadmapIssues
  KonyklabsRoadmapIssues -. "`the spike ends in an ADR`" .-> KonyklabsRoadmapAdrs
  KonyklabsRoadmapAdrs -. "`which becomes build issues`" .-> KonyklabsRoadmapIssues
  KonyklabsRoadmapIssues -. "`branch <type>/<issue>-<slug>, then a PR 
carrying #N`" .-> Github
  Github -. "`conventional subject + task ref, or no 
merge`" .-> KonyklabsDotgithubTitleLint
  Github -. "`paths-only proprietary-terms backstop`" .-> KonyklabsDotgithubScan
  Github -. "`triage, lenses, judge, verdict`" .-> KonyklabsDotgithubGate
  KonyklabsDotgithubGate -. "`one review: approve, or request-changes`" .-> Github
  Github -. "`the merge bar: green checks, an explicit 
verdict, every comment answered`" .-> Oleg
  Oleg -. "`squash merge — the PR title is the 
commit subject`" .-> KonyklabsSite
  KonyklabsSite -. "`semver tag, never hand-tagged`" .-> KonyklabsDotgithubReleasePlease
```
